cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've turned my cup over like yours. Ready for another round. Stay until I can tell the children about tomorrow's operation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My cup's upside down because I'm finished. We've had three rounds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, finished with tea. Let me practise the first sentence on you before I fetch them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask for two minutes. Let me say 'I'll be in hospital' without stopping. Then I'll tell them myself.

reason: Make copied confidence create a specific misunderstanding in the same emotional task; preserve B contribution and avoid turning vulnerable requests into rubric explanations.
